responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible floating-point string conversion API for GNU Modula-2. It owns procedures for formatting REAL and LONGREAL values into caller-provided character arrays with configurable fixed-point or exponent notation and exponent width, and for parsing strings back into floating values with an explicit success flag.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the RealConversions pair: it specifies the floating-point string conversion API, including exponent-digit control and parse/format procedures, while RealConversions.mod implements the conversion engine.
